At RAN5#76 the work plan was created in [1]. The work plan currently includes 641 (-98) Rel-14 CA configurations. This number decrease due to RAN4 close of the Rel-14 CA basket work items and either removed the CA configurations or moved them to Rel-15 CA basket work items. At RAN5#76 there were 55 CRs agreed ([2] to [56]. See section 3 for complete list of contributions. Overall 163 (+19) out of the 641 CA configurations have been assigned to companies. Each company acts as sub-WI rapporteurs for their assigned CA configurations. NOTE: Usually, at the beginning of a WI/SI the list of open issues is copied from the objectives of the WID/SID into this open issues list.
